# testdata/settle1f

Synthetic fixtures for the SETTLE-1f acceptance (dist/test/settle1f.sh): the one layout of
referenced entries and thread clusters that stay on thread. Every person, place and date here is
invented. `garden/` is a diary: four entries of the thread garden-plan (two tagged with it, one
tagged continuing-thread:garden-plan, one titled with it) and six that share only generic tags
with them; the test fills in `@PERSON@` with the install's person name. `rollup-layout.md` is a
writer reply in the layout, `rollup-single-label.md` the same in the older single-label form,
`rollup-unlabelled.md` the same with a paragraph naming an entry without the label.
`select-*.json` are the select step's replies; `orchard-entry.md` is the template of the cap
check's 30 entries (`@N@` filled in).
